title: The Girl From The Farm — Mbira Folk (Zimbabwe)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm alto female lead vocal 82bpm analog tape warm heritage storytelling Zimbabwe Australia
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
She grew up knowing what four AM felt like
The dairy cold, the cows already patient
Her mother showing her that the farm doesn't wait
For readiness — it only waits for you to arrive

[Verse 2]
She was quiet in the way that confident women are quiet
Not absent — present, just not loud about it
Joel found this the most remarkable thing
A stillness that contained everything

[Chorus]
The girl from the farm
Carried the red dust to the sea
The girl from the farm
Brought the mbira into our family
She brought Jeff's rows and Jill's four AM
The girl from the farm — Kerri — came home again

[Bridge]
Australia is not the ending of Zimbabwe
It is the place where Zimbabwe grows differently
In the way Kerri walks into a room
In the way she holds a morning
In the way Ari sings before she knows the words

[Verse 3]
They had a daughter who sings both lands at once
Who doesn't know she does it yet
But you can hear it — the farm in the lower notes
The sea in the high ones
And somewhere in between — the mbira, still playing

[Outro]
The girl from the farm
The girl from the farm
Kerri came home
The mbira plays on
